records.failureSummary: Added AC-named unit tests in test/slugify.ac.test.mjs (9 tests [AC-01]..[AC-09]) covering FR-1 lowercase (slugify('ABC')=='abc', slugify('Hello World')=='hello-world'), FR-2 trim (slugify('  Hello World  ')=='hello-world', slugify('  hello  ')=='hello'), FR-3 contiguous whitespace runs incl. spaces/tabs/newlines (slugify('Hello   World')=='hello-world', slugify('a\\tb')=='a-b', slugify('a\\nb')=='a-b'), FR-4 disallowed symbols to hyphen (slugify('a_b.c/d')=='a-b-c-d', slugify('foo+bar=baz')=='foo-bar-baz') and FR-8 Unicode preservation incl. Chinese (slugify('标题 测试')=='标题-测试', slugify('中文123')=='中文123'). Red phase shown first without modifying product code: the identical AC assertions were run against an unimplemented stub in a temporary scratch file (throw new Error) and all 9 failed (not ok 1..9; tests 9, pass 0, fail 9). Scratch was then deleted. Green phase against the existing implementation: 9/9 AC tests pass and the full project suite is 12/12 (fail 0). Gates node --check (lint/build) report no errors. No product code was changed by this task; pnpm is not installed in the sandbox so the script bodies were executed via their underlying node commands.
